quest.title: The Missing Person
quest.description: Bantan Sango Detective Agency issued a curious commission. You wonder what case it is that even detectives have gotten out of their depths.

chapter.num: Hangout Event: Shikanoin Heizou - Act I
chapter.title: Trap 'Em by Storm

talks.objective: Go to Bantan Sango Detective Agency

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: What if the Traveler is also unavailable... What am I supposed to do?

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Well, that's your problem. It was your choice to get into this mess.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Oh, but fortunately for you, it appears your savior has just arrived.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Hmm? Ah, Traveler! Great, you made it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't worry, I'm available.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Well, it's not like you were ever really busy to begin with.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Ugh, Sango!

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Compared to the Traveler, you're the one who has too much free time.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: No, I'm very busy. I'm busy standing here... I have to stand here all day.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Even if it's a commission you're unwilling to take, your excuse is just pathetic.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A commission you're unwilling to take?

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Yes, that's why I've asked you to come over. Allow me to explain.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: A key member of the Tenryou Commission has recently gone missing. No one has seen them and their whereabouts are currently unknown.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: The Tenryou Commission has entrusted us to find this person discreetly because it would be a hassle for them to look for this person openly, for a variety of reasons.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Their name is...

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Kujou Sara. That's right, the general has gone missing.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: *sigh* ...If the general was really missing, the Tenryou Commission would have flipped Inazuma on its head by now. And do you think they would only commission us for a case like that?

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Please ignore Sango's nonsense, Traveler. In fact, the missing person's name is Shikanoin Heizou.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: He works as a special detective at the Police Station. Although his rank is merely a Doushin, he is quite competent and held in high regard by the Police Station.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Ah! Do they think he's more competent than me?

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: *sigh* We get that you don't want to help, Sango, but could you at least try not to make things more difficult here.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Sorry Traveler, even though I accepted the commission...

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: As you can see, Sango's less than thrilled to be involved in this case.

choices.text: Because the pay is too low?

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: Nope! Not even close!

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: If you really want to know why, it's because I absolutely refuse to deal with that brat's nonsense.

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: The only news that could make me happier than "Shikanoin has gone missing," would be "Shikanoin has been missing for 100 years."

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Ahem... Needless to say, Sango and Heizou have a bit of a history.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I see what you mean... they're competitors.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Hum... Ah well, it's a little more serious than that.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: According to Sango, Heizou was an obstacle in her path to the "Temple of Truth"...

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: Like a yappy dog that was constantly in the way!

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: *sigh* Even though Heizou has... a "unique" personality, he's actually a nice guy. Really, I've learned a lot from him.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: So I can't just ignore this case, even if Sango doesn't approve. At the very least, I could entrust the commission to someone capable and trustworthy... like you, Traveler!

choices.text: I see, so you're outsourcing it to me.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Huh? No no, it's not like that! Listen, I'll pay the entire amount originally promised by the Tenryou Commission, and I'll even personally throw in some additional funds.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: I'm really hoping you can take this commission, Traveler.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: If Heizou truly is in danger, I know he'll be safer with you by his side.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Actually, we get along great, but Sango has always asked me to keep my distance and not to act like I know him in public settings.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: So, when people ask, I usually just say I've met Shikanoin a few times. If it hadn't been for today's incident, I'd...

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Ahem... Well, let's not get into that. Anyway, could you please help look for him?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Understood, I'll head there immediately.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Well, that's about all I have to tell you. Oh, please take this commission letter from the Police Station. If you find Heizou, return there and report back to them.

choices.text: No problem, but I'll need more information.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Great! We've learned that Heizou had expressed interest in Watatsumi Island before he disappeared.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: During the war, he apparently carried out some mission on Watatsumi Island, and once the war ended, he made frequent visits to the island.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: I heard you have a good standing with Sangonomiya. I think it might be a good idea to use that as a starting point for your investigation.

choices.text: I see, so you're basically the middleman.
Because there are too few clues?

dialogues.speaker: Shibata
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you...! The captain of Swordfish II! My name is Shibata. I'm in charge of the watch here. May I inquire as to what the captain needs?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm here for information about a specific individual.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Shibata about the commission to find Heizou.

dialogues.speaker: Shibata
dialogues.text: So his name is Shikanoin Heizou, huh? Yes, I'm familiar with the detective, he used to stroll around the area.

dialogues.speaker: Shibata
dialogues.text: Her Excellency had assigned me to keep a close eye on him at the time, fearing that he would do something unpleasant, but I eventually realized that he acted more like he was on a trip or something.

dialogues.speaker: Shibata
dialogues.text: Come to think of it, I believe he was recently spotted in the area east of the Sangonomiya Shrine. Please feel free to go there and take a look for yourself.

talks.objective: Go to the east side of Watatsumi Island and look for Heizou
Talk to the young man you rescued

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: There's no time for delay, Traveler. Oh, I sure hope Heizou isn't in any danger.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me more about Shikanoin Heizou.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Oh, Heizou is quite the lively fellow! He's super talkative, active, and energetic, and he's always on the move.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Sango always compares him to a buzzing housefly... which I guess must be because he can accurately sniff out every bad apple in the pile.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: In which case, Heizou isn't just some ordinary housefly, he's like the ace of flies!

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Even with his nose plugged, eyes blindfolded, and ears covered, Heizou could still pinpoint the bad apples.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: His skills are amazing, it's almost as if he relies on something other than just his five senses... You know, like a sixth sense! Or maybe it's pure intuition? Or he has divine favor? It's gotta be something like that...

choices.text: I see what you're getting at, but I think that's enough of the fly metaphor for now.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: *sigh* Sango always says I make a fool of myself when I talk. I guess she's right...

choices.text: The whole fly metaphor is pretty bad, but I'd still like to hear more.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Ahem... Well, maybe we should chat another time. Sango is starting to stare at us.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: You still haven't left yet? So perhaps you've changed your mind about looking for Heizou, huh? That would be best. Take it from me, getting involved with that guy is never a good idea.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm curious, what's your issue with him?

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Let me put it this way, it wouldn't bother me at all if he disappeared forever. That's my issue.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Smile slightly and nod along.)

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Don't give me that look. Everyone's allowed to have a few people they can't stand, right?

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: *sigh* In any case, I guess you should get moving, before that Shikanoin causes too much trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: By the way, if you do happen to come across any signs of a most unfortunate demise, be sure to notify me... It'll bring me great joy.

dialogues.speaker: Shibata
dialogues.text: If you are looking for the young detective, please go to the area east of the Sangonomiya Shrine.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Hmm? Didn't you go looking for that brat Shikanoin?

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Investigate? Why would I come to investigate his nonsense? Hmph! I was tired of staying in town, so I decided to go out for a walk.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: So get out of my hair and go back to whatever you were doing.
